tasks.prompt: In my workspace, fix date-filter.py: records on the end date are excluded but the spec says the end date is inclusive. Fix the comparison and add a comment explaining it.

files.check_filter.py:
import importlib.util
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("date_filter", Path(__file__).parent / "date-filter.py")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
assert module.in_range(date(2026, 11, 10), date(2026, 11, 1), date(2026, 11, 10)) is True
assert module.in_range(date(2026, 11, 11), date(2026, 11, 1), date(2026, 11, 10)) is False
print("filter checks ok")
files.date-filter.py:
